lemma regen_getEndpoint_lookupAround_endpoint_slot:
  "ep_at' ptr s \<Longrightarrow>
   \<exists>ep after. lookupAround2 (fromPPtr ptr) (psMap (ksPSpace s)) = (Some (fromPPtr ptr, KOEndpoint ep), after) \<and>
              is_aligned (fromPPtr ptr) (objBits ep) \<and>
              (after = None \<or> (\<exists>next. after = Some next \<and> \<not> next - fromPPtr ptr < 2 ^ objBits ep))"
node.strategy: Use ep_at' with ps_clear_lookupAround2 at fromPPtr ptr and keep the result in lookupAround2 form, exposing the endpoint object, alignment, and successor-separation condition needed by getObject/loadObject.

failed_attempts.proof_body:
proof -
  assume ep: "ep_at' ptr s"
  then obtain ep where
      ksp: "ksPSpace s ptr = Some (KOEndpoint ep)"
    and al: "is_aligned ptr (objBitsKO (KOEndpoint ep))"
    and clr: "ps_clear ptr (objBitsKO (KOEndpoint ep)) s"
    by (erule Invariants_H.obj_atE'; clarsimp simp: Invariants_H.projectKO_eq ObjectInstances_H.projectKO_opt_ep split: Structures_H.kernel_object.splits)
  have la: "fst (lookupAround2 ptr (ksPSpace s)) = Some (ptr, KOEndpoint ep)"
    and aft: "case snd (lookupAround2 ptr (ksPSpace s)) of None \<Rightarrow> True | Some x \<Rightarrow> 2 ^ objBitsKO (KOEndpoint ep) \<le> x - ptr"
    by (rule Invariants_H.ps_clear_lookupAround2[OF clr ksp]; simp add: Invariants_H.objBits_simps'(2))+
  show "\<exists>ep after. lookupAround2 (fromPPtr ptr) (psMap (ksPSpace s)) = (Some (fromPPtr ptr, KOEndpoint ep), after) \<and>
              is_aligned (fromPPtr ptr) (objBits ep) \<and>
              (after = None \<or> (\<exists>next. after = Some next \<and> \<not> next - fromPPtr ptr < 2 ^ objBits ep))"
    using la aft al
    by (cases "snd (lookupAround2 ptr (ksPSpace s))"; fastforce simp: State_H.ARM_H.fromPPtr_def PSpaceStorable_H.pre_storable_class.objBits_def Invariants_H.objBits_simps'(2))
qed
